title: nsresourced: harden the transient UID/GID write restriction

target.summary: manager_attach_bpf() returns an error when userns_restrict_attach() fails, which manager_startup() treats as a fatal error. On kernels where BPF-LSM programs can be loaded but not attached (such as arm64 prior to kernel 7.2), systemd-nsresourced fails to start instead of disabling user namespace interfaces and continuing.
notes: faulty statement returning an error on attach failure instead of disabling userns interfaces and continuing
definition of the function whose behavior is wrong
call site in manager_startup that treats attach failure as fatal
